The firm invests on behalf of clients who seek allocations to alternative investments, such as private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return strategies. It specializes in developing customized portfolios for clients who want an active role in the development of their alternatives programs and also offers multi-client portfolios for investors who desire a turn-key solution for accessing alternative investments. The company's offerings include multi-manager portfolios as well as portfolios of direct investments and co-investments. GCM Grosvenor has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, Tokyo, Hong Kong, and Seoul. GCM Grosvenor was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: GCM Grosvenor, Inc. 提供全球另類資產管理解決方案。該公司代表尋求另類投資配置的客戶進行投資，例如私募股權、基礎設施、房地產、信貸和絕對回報策略。它專門為希望在另類投資項目開發中發揮積極作用的客戶開發客製化投資組合，並為希望獲得另類投資交鑰匙解決方案的投資者提供多客戶投資組合。該公司的產品包括多管理人投資組合以及直接投資和共同投資組合。 GCM Grosvenor 在紐約、洛杉磯、倫敦、東京、香港和首爾設有辦事處。 GCM Grosvenor 成立於 1971 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Fastenal Co. engages in the distribution of fasteners and tools. It also operates hardware stores. The company was founded by Robert A. Kierlin, Michael M. Gostomski, Henry K. McConnon, John D. Remick, and Stephen M. Slaggie in November 1967 and is headquartered in Winona, MN.
info.description_zh: Fastenal Co. 從事緊固件和工具的分銷。它還經營五金店。該公司由 Robert A. Kierlin、Michael M. Gostomski、Henry K. McConnon、John D. Remick 和 Stephen M. Slaggie 於 1967 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州威諾納。

info.description: Dorman Products, Inc. engages in the supply of automotive replacement and upgrade parts for the motor vehicle aftermarket industry. Its products include automotive body, steering and suspension, undercar, underhood, hardware and accessories, and heavy-duty components. The company was founded by Steven L. Berman and Richard N. Berman on October 16, 1978 and is headquartered in Colmar, PA.
info.description_zh: Dorman Products, Inc. 致力於為機動車輛售後市場產業供應汽車更換和升級零件。其產品包括汽車車身、轉向和懸吊、車底、引擎蓋、硬體和配件以及重型零件。該公司由 Steven L. Berman 和 Richard N. Berman 於 1978 年 10 月 16 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州科爾馬。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Medical ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in common stocks, convertible securities, warrants and other equity securities having the characteristics of common stocks of U.S. and foreign companies engaged in medical research, pharmaceutical and medical technology industries and related technology industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Medical ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，透過將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於從事醫學研究、製藥和醫療技術行業及相關技術行業的美國和外國公司的普通股、可轉換證券、認股權證和其他具有普通股特徵的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Portfolio Building Block World Pharma And Biotech Index ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA Global Pharma and Biotech Select Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is constructed using a rules-based methodology that identifies companies in the pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industries with publicly traded ordinary shares listed on major stock exchanges in developed markets, as classified by BITA GmbH. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's net assets in component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 投資組合建構模組世界製藥和生技指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 BITA 全球製藥和生技精選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該基金採用「被動管理」方法來追蹤該指數未計費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法構建，該方法識別在已開發市場主要證券交易所上市的公開交易普通股的製藥和/或生物技術行業的公司（按 BITA GmbH 的分類）。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的基金淨資產投資於構成指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It operates through the Consumer Banking and Commercial Banking segments. The Consumer Banking segment includes deposit products, mortgage and home equity lending, student loans, auto financing, credit cards, business loans, and wealth management and investment services. The Commercial Banking segment offers lending and leasing, trade financing, deposit and treasury management, foreign exchange and interest rate risk management, corporate finance, and debt, and equity capital markets. The company was founded in 1828 and is headquartered in Providence, RI.
info.description_zh: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. 從事提供商業銀行服務。它透過消費者銀行和商業銀行部門運作。消費者銀行業務部門包括存款產品、抵押貸款和房屋淨值貸款、學生貸款、汽車融資、信用卡、商業貸款以及財富管理和投資服務。商業銀行部門提供貸款和租賃、貿易融資、存款和財務管理、外匯和利率風險管理、企業融資以及債務和股權資本市場。該公司成立於 1828 年，總部位於羅德島州普羅維登斯。

info.description: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of containment and delivery systems for injectable drugs and healthcare products. It operates through the Proprietary Products and Contract-Manufactured Products segments. The Proprietary Products segment offers proprietary packaging, containment solutions, drug delivery systems, analytical lab services, and other integrated services and solutions, primarily to biologic, generic, and pharmaceutical drug customers. The Contract-Manufactured Products segment serves as a fully integrated business focused on the design, manufacture, and automated assembly of complex devices, primarily for pharmaceutical, diagnostic, and medical device customers. The company was founded by Herman O. West on July 27, 1923 and is headquartered in Exton, PA.
info.description_zh: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. 從事注射藥物和醫療保健產品的密封和輸送系統的設計、製造和銷售。它透過專有產品和合約製造產品部門運作。專有產品部門主要向生物藥品、仿製藥和製藥藥品客戶提供專有包裝、密封解決方案、給藥系統、分析實驗室服務以及其他綜合服務和解決方案。合約製造產品部門是一個完全整合的業務，專注於複雜設備的設計、製造和自動化組裝，主要針對製藥、診斷和醫療設備客戶。該公司由 Herman O. West 於 1923 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州埃克斯頓。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Health Care ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of health care companies. The manager defines health care companies as companies engaged in health care innovations, such as developing new and effective therapies; pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; life sciences tools and services; managed health care; and/or health care equipment, supplies, providers, services, distributors, and facilities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 醫療保健 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於醫療保健公司的證券。這位經理將醫療保健公司定義為從事醫療保健創新的公司，例如開發新的有效療法；藥品；生物技術；生命科學工具和服務；管理醫療保健；和/或醫療保健設備、用品、提供者、服務、分銷商和設施。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco BuyBack Achievers ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ US BuyBack AchieversTM Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The NASDAQ includes common stocks in the underlying index pursuant to a proprietary selection methodology that identifies a universe of "BuyBack Achievers TM".
info.description_zh: Invesco BuyBack Achievers ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克美國 BuyBack AchieversTM 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克根據專有的選擇方法將普通股納入基礎指數中，該方法確定了「BuyBack Achievers TM」的範圍。

info.description: ProLogis provides distribution facilities and real investment trust services. It leases its industrial facilities to manufacturers, retailers and transportation companies. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 工業
info.description_zh: 普洛斯提供分銷設施和真實投資信託服務。它將工業設施出租給製造商、零售商和運輸公司。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Sotera Health Co. provides mission-critical sterilization, lab testing and advisory services to the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. It also provides end-to-end sterilization as well as microbiological and analytical lab testing and advisory services to help ensure that medical, pharmaceutical and food products are safe for healthcare practitioners, patients and consumers. The firm operates through the following businesses: Sterigenics, Nordion, and Nelson Labs. The Sterigenics business provides outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and advanced applications markets by using following technologies: gamma irradiation, EO processing and E-beam irradiation. The Nordion business provides Co-60 and gamma irradiators, which are the key components to the gamma sterilization process. The Nelson Labs business provides outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Broadview Heights, OH.
info.description_zh: Sotera Health Co. 為醫療器材和製藥業提供關鍵任務滅菌、實驗室測試和諮詢服務。它還提供端到端滅菌以及微生物和分析實驗室測試和諮詢服務，以幫助確保醫療、藥品和食品對醫療保健從業者、患者和消費者來說是安全的。該公司透過以下業務運營：Sterigenics、Nordion 和 Nelson Labs。 Sterigenics 業務透過使用以下技術為醫療器材、製藥、食品安全和先進應用市場提供外包終端滅菌和輻照服務：伽馬輻照、EO 處理和電子束輻照。 Nordion 業務提供 Co-60 和伽馬輻照器，它們是伽馬滅菌過程的關鍵組件。尼爾森實驗室業務為醫療器材和製藥業提供外包微生物和分析化學測試和諮詢服務。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於俄亥俄州布羅德維尤高地。

info.description: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of orthopedic reconstructive products. The firm also offers sports medicine, biologics, extremities, and trauma products, spine, craniomaxillofacial, and thoracic products, office-based technologies, dental implants, and related surgical products. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment consists of the U.S. and includes other North, Central and South American markets. The Europe Middle East and Africa segment includes France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom. The Asia Pacific segment refers to the key markets such as Japan, China, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Malaysia. The company was founded by Justin O. Zimmer in 1927 and is headquartered in Warsaw, IN.
info.description_zh: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. 從事骨科重建產品的設計、製造和行銷。該公司還提供運動醫學、生物製品、四肢和創傷產品、脊椎、顱顏面和胸部產品、辦公室技術、牙科植體和相關外科產品。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。美洲部分包括美國以及其他北美、中美和南美市場。歐洲、中東和非洲部分包括法國、德國、義大利、西班牙和英國。亞太地區是指日本、中國、澳洲、紐西蘭、韓國、台灣、印度、泰國、新加坡、香港和馬來西亞等主要市場。該公司由 Justin O. Zimmer 於 1927 年創立，總部位於印第安納州華沙。

info.description: Abbott Laboratories engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of healthcare products. It operates through the following segments: Established Pharmaceutical Products, Diagnostic Products, Nutritional Products, and Medical Devices. The Established Pharmaceutical Products segment focuses on branded generic pharmaceuticals that are manufactured worldwide and marketed and sold outside the United States, primarily in emerging markets. The Diagnostic Products segment markets diagnostic systems and tests for blood banks, hospitals, commercial laboratories, clinics, physicians' offices, retailers, government agencies, and alternative care testing sites. The Nutritional Products segment oversees the worldwide sale of pediatric and adult nutritional products. The Medical Devices segment offers a broad range of rhythm management, electrophysiology, heart failure, vascular and structural heart devices for the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, as well as diabetes care and continuous glucose monitoring products. It also provides neuromodulation devices for the management of chronic pain and movement disorders The company was founded by Wallace Calvin Abbott in 1888 and is headquartered in Abbott Park, IL.
info.description_zh: 雅培實驗室從事醫療保健產品的發現、開發、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：成熟的藥品部門、診斷產品部門、營養產品部門和醫療器材部門。老牌藥品部門專注於在全球生產並在美國境外（主要是新興市場）行銷和銷售的品牌仿製藥。診斷產品部門為血庫、醫院、商業實驗室、診所、醫生辦公室、零售商、政府機構和替代護理測試場所銷售診斷系統和測試。營養產品部門負責監督兒科和成人營養產品的全球銷售。醫療器材部門提供廣泛的節律管理、電生理學、心臟衰竭、用於治療心血管疾病的血管和結構性心臟設備，以及糖尿病護理和連續血糖監測產品。它還提供用於治療慢性疼痛和運動障礙的神經調節設備。該公司由 Wallace Calvin Abbott 於 1888 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州雅培公園。

info.description: thredUP, Inc. operates as an online clothing resale platform for apparel, shoes, and accessories. Its brands include J.Crew, Ann Taylor, Banana Republic, Lululemon Athletica, Talbots, and Madewell. It operates through the United States and Others geographical segments. The company was founded by James Reinhart, Chris Homer, and Oliver Lubin in January 2009 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: thredUP, Inc. 是一家線上服裝轉售平台，銷售服裝、鞋子和配件。其品牌包括 J.Crew、Ann Taylor、Banana Republic、Lululemon Athletica、Talbots 和 Madewell。它透過美國和其他地區的地理部門開展業務。該公司由 James Reinhart、Chris Homer 和 Oliver Lubin 於 2009 年 1 月創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: Masco Corp. designs, manufactures, and distributes branded home improvement and building products. It operates through the Plumbing Products and Decorative Architectural Products segments. The Plumbing Products segment includes faucets, showerheads, handheld showers, valves, bath hardware and accessories, bathing units, shower bases and enclosures, shower drains, steam shower systems, sinks, kitchen accessories, and toilets. The Decorative Architectural Products segment focuses on architectural coatings, including paints, primers, specialty coatings, stains and waterproofing products, and paint applicators and accessories. The company was founded by Alex Manoogian in 1929 and is headquartered in Livonia, MI.
info.description_zh: Masco Corp. 設計、製造和分銷品牌家居裝修和建築產品。它透過管道產品和裝飾建築產品部門運作。水暖產品部門包括水龍頭、淋浴頭、手持花灑、閥門、浴室五金和配件、沐浴裝置、淋浴底座和外殼、淋浴排水管、蒸汽淋浴系統、水槽、廚房配件和馬桶。裝飾建築產品部門專注於建築塗料，包括油漆、底漆、特殊塗料、著色劑和防水產品以及塗漆器和配件。該公司由 Alex Manoogian 於 1929 年創立，總部位於密西根州利沃尼亞。

info.description: Snap-On, Inc. engages in the manufacture and marketing of tools, equipment, diagnostics, repair information, and systems solutions for professional users performing critical tasks. Its products and services include hand and power tools, tool storage, diagnostics software, handheld and PC-based diagnostic products, information and management systems, shop equipment and other solutions for vehicle dealerships and repair centers, as well as for customers in industries such as aviation and aerospace, agriculture, construction, government and military, mining, natural resources, power generation, and technical education. It operates through the following segments: Commercial and Industrial Group, Snap-On Tools Group, Repair Systems and Information Group, and Financial Services. The Commercial and Industrial Group segment consists of business operations that serve the aerospace, natural resources, government, power generation, transportation, and technical education markets. The Snap-On Tools Group segment includes business operations primarily serving vehicle service and repair technicians through its worldwide mobile tool distribution channel. The Repair System and Information Group segment serves professional vehicle repair customers, primarily owners and managers of independent repair shops and original equipment manufacturer dealerships through direct and distributor channels. The Financial Services segment consists of installment sales and lease contracts arising from franchisees' customers, and business loans and vehicle leases to franchisees. The company was founded by Joseph Johnson and William Seidemann in 1920 and is headquartered in Kenosha, WI.
info.description_zh: Snap-On, Inc. 致力於為執行關鍵任務的專業使用者製造和行銷工具、設備、診斷、維修資訊和系統解決方案。其產品和服務包括手動和電動工具、工具儲存、診斷軟體、手持式和基於PC的診斷產品、資訊和管理系統、車間設備和其他解決方案，面向汽車經銷商和維修中心，以及航空航天、農業、建築、政府和軍事、採礦、自然資源、發電和技術教育等行業的客戶。該公司透過以下部門運作：商業和工業部門、實耐寶工具部門、維修系統和資訊部門以及金融服務部門。商業和工業集團部門包括服務於航空航太、自然資源、政府、發電、運輸和技術教育市場的業務運作。實耐寶工具集團業務部門主要透過其全球行動工具分銷管道為車輛服務和維修技術人員提供服務。維修系統和資訊集團部門透過直接和分銷管道為專業車輛維修客戶提供服務，主要是獨立維修店和原始設備製造商經銷商的所有者和經理。金融服務部門包括特許經營商客戶產生的分期銷售和租賃合同，以及向特許經營商提供的商業貸款和車輛租賃。該公司由 Joseph Johnson 和 William Seidemann 於 1920 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州基諾沙。

info.description: Edison International is a renewable energy company, which through its subsidiaries, generates and distributes electric power, and invests in energy services and technologies. The company was founded on July 4, 1886, and is headquartered in Rosemead, CA.

info.description_zh: 愛迪生國際是一家再生能源公司，透過其子公司生產和分配電力，並投資能源服務和技術。該公司成立於 1886 年 7 月 4 日，總部位於加利福尼亞州羅斯米德。

info.description: Invesco Water Resources ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ OMX US Water IndexSM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to track the performance of companies that create products designed to conserve and purify water for homes, businesses and industries. The underlying index may include common stocks, ordinary shares, American depositary receipts ("ADRs"), shares of beneficial interest and tracking stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Water Resources ETF 旨在追蹤 NASDAQ OMX US Water IndexSM（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤那些為家庭、企業和工業生產節約和淨化用水的產品的公司的表現。標的指數可能包括普通股、普通股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、受益股和追蹤股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ecolab, Inc. engages in providing products and services in the field of water, hygiene, and energy. It operates through the following segments: Global Industrial, Global Institutional and Specialty, Global Healthcare and Life Sciences, Global Pest Elimination, and Corporate. The Global Industrial segment relates to water, food and beverage, paper, and downstream operating segments. The Global Institutional and Specialty segment refers to the institutional, specialty, and healthcare operating segments. The Global Healthcare and Life Sciences segment includes the healthcare and life sciences operations. The Global Pest Elimination segment provides services designed to detect, prevent and eliminate pests, such as rodents and insects, in full-service and quick-service restaurants, food and beverage processors, hotels, grocery operations, and other. The company was founded by Merritt J. Osborn in 1923 and is headquartered in St. Paul, MN.
info.description_zh: Ecolab, Inc. 致力於提供水、衛生和能源領域的產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：全球工業部門、全球機構和專業部門、全球醫療保健和生命科學部門、全球害蟲消除部門和企業部門。全球工業部門涉及水、食品和飲料、造紙和下游營運部門。全球機構和專業部門是指機構、專業和醫療保健營運部門。全球醫療保健和生命科學部門包括醫療保健和生命科學業務。全球害蟲消除部門提供旨在檢測、預防和消除害蟲（例如囓齒動物和昆蟲）的服務，適用於全方位服務和快速服務的餐廳、食品和飲料加工商、酒店、雜貨店等。該公司由 Merritt J. Osborn 於 1923 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州聖保羅。

info.description: D.R. Horton, Inc. engages in the construction and sale of single-family housing. It operates through the following geographical segments: Northwest, Southwest, South Central, Southeast, East, and North. The Northwest segment relates to Colorado, Oregon, Utah, and Washington. The Southwest segment covers Arizona, California, Hawaii, Nevada, and New Mexico. The South Central segment is involved in Arkansas, Oklahoma, and Texas. The Southeast segment refers to Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, and Mississippi. The East segment operates Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Tennessee. The North segment focuses on Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and West Virginia. The company was founded by Donald Ray Horton in 1978 and is headquartered in Arlington, TX.
info.description_zh: 博士Horton, Inc. 從事單戶住宅的建設和銷售。它透過以下地理區域運作：西北、西南、中南、東南、東部和北部。西北段涉及科羅拉多州、俄勒岡州、猶他州和華盛頓州。西南部包括亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、夏威夷州、內華達州和新墨西哥州。中南部部分涉及阿肯色州、俄克拉荷馬州和德克薩斯州。東南部分是指阿拉巴馬州、佛羅裡達州、路易斯安那州和密西西比州。東部部門經營喬治亞州、北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州和田納西州。北部部分主要集中在德拉瓦州、伊利諾州、印第安納州、愛荷華州、肯塔基州、馬裡蘭州、明尼蘇達州、內布拉斯加州、紐澤西州、俄亥俄州、賓州、維吉尼亞州和西維吉尼亞州。該公司由 Donald Ray Horton 於 1978 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州阿靈頓。

info.description: Sanofi engages in the research, production, and distribution of pharmaceutical products. It operates through the Biopharma segment, which comprises commercial operations and research, development and production activities relating to the specialty care, general medicines and vaccines franchises plus support and corporate functions, for all geographical territories. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: 賽諾菲從事醫藥產品的研究、生產和分銷。該公司透過生物製藥部門運營，該部門包括與所有地理區域的專業護理、普通藥物和疫苗特許經營權以及支持和公司職能相關的商業運營以及研究、開發和生產活動。該公司成立於1973年，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF seeks maximum total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in securities and financial instruments linked to the S&P 500 Index. The fund manager takes both long and short positions by investing in e-mini futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in large cap equities or investments with similar characteristics, or cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF 尋求最大的總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (ETF)，旨在透過投資與標準普爾 500 指數掛鉤的證券和金融工具來實現其投資目標。基金經理人透過投資電子迷你期貨合約來持有多頭和空頭部位。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於大盤股或具有類似特徵的投資，或現金及現金等價物。

info.description: Parker-Hannifin Corp. engages in the manufacture of motion and control technologies and systems. It operates through the Diversified Industrial and Aerospace Systems segments. The Diversified Industrial segment sells products to both original equipment manufacturers and distributors who serve the replacement markets in manufacturing, packaging, processing, transportation, mobile construction, refrigeration and air conditioning, agricultural and military machinery, and equipment industries. The Aerospace Systems segment offers products primarily in the commercial and military aerospace markets to both OEMs and to end users for spares, maintenance, repair, and overhaul. The company was founded by Arthur L. Parker in 1918 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: Parker-Hannifin Corp. 從事運動和控制技術及系統的製造。它透過多元化工業和航空航天系統部門運作。多元化工業部門向原始設備製造商和分銷商銷售產品，這些製造商和分銷商服務於製造、包裝、加工、運輸、移動建築、製冷和空調、農業和軍用機械以及設備行業的替代市場。航空航太系統部門主要在商業和軍用航空航太市場向原始設備製造商和最終用戶提供備件、維護、修理和大修產品。該公司由 Arthur L. Parker 於 1918 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: CECO Environmental Corp. engages in the provision of engineering technology and solutions. It offers services in the field of environment, energy, fluid handling, and filtration. The firm operates through the following segments: Engineered Systems and Industrial Process Solutions segment. The Engineered Systems segment serves the power generation, hydrocarbon processing, water/wastewater treatment, oily water separation and treatment, marine and naval vessels, and midstream oil and gas sectors. The Industrial Process Solutions segment serves the broad industrial sector with solutions for air pollution and contamination control, fluid handling, and process filtration in applications such as aluminum beverage can production, automobile production, food and beverage processing, semiconductor fabrication, electronics production, steel and aluminum mill processing, wood manufacturing, desalination, and aquaculture markets. The company was founded by Phillip DeZwirek in 1966 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: 希柯環保股份有限公司從事提供工程技術和解決方案。它提供環境、能源、流體處理和過濾領域的服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：工程系統和工業過程解決方案部門。工程系統部門服務於發電、碳氫化合物加工、水/廢水處理、含油水分離和處理、船舶和中游石油和天然氣領域。工業製程解決方案部門為廣泛的工業領域提供空氣污染和污染控制、流體處理和製程過濾解決方案，應用於鋁製飲料罐生產、汽車生產、食品和飲料加工、半導體製造、電子產品生產、鋼鐵和鋁廠加工、木材製造、海水淡化和水產養殖市場。該公司由 Phillip DeZwirek 於 1966 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Amgen, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and marketing of human therapeutics. The company was founded by William K. Bowes, Jr., Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr., George B. Rathmann, and Joseph Rubinfeld on April 8, 1980 and is headquartered in Thousand Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: 安進公司是一家生技公司，從事人類治療藥物的發現、開發、製造和行銷。該公司由 William K. Bowes, Jr.、Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr.、George B. Rathmann 和 Joseph Rubinfeld 於 1980 年 4 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州千橡市。

info.description: PACCAR, Inc. is a global technology company, which engages in the design and manufacture of light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks. It operates through the following segments: Truck, Parts, and Financial Services. The Truck segment designs and manufactures heavy, medium, and light duty diesel trucks which are marketed under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF brands. The Parts segment distributes aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles. The Financial Services segment provides finance and leasing products and services provided to truck customers and dealers. The company was founded by William Pigott Sr. in 1905 and is headquartered in Bellevue, WA.
info.description_zh: PACCAR, Inc.是一家全球科技公司，從事輕型、中型和重型卡車的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：卡車部門、零件部門和金融服務部門。卡車部門設計和製造重型、中型和輕型柴油卡車，並以 Kenworth、Peterbilt 和 DAF 品牌銷售。零件部門分銷卡車和相關商用車的售後零件。金融服務部門為卡車客戶和經銷商提供融資和租賃產品及服務。該公司由 William Pigott Sr. 於 1905 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州貝爾維尤。

info.description: Woodward, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of control solutions for the aerospace and industrial markets. It operates through the Aerospace and Industrial segments. The Aerospace segment involves the design, manufacture, services systems, and products for the management of fuel, air, combustion, and motion control. The Industrial segment includes the management of fuel, air, fluids, gases, electricity, motion, and combustion. The company was founded by Amos W. Woodward in 1870 and is headquartered in Fort Collins, CO.
info.description_zh: Woodward, Inc. 致力於為航空航太和工業市場設計和製造控制解決方案。它透過航空航天和工業部門運作。航空航天部門涉及燃料、空氣、燃燒和運動控制管理的設計、製造、服務系統和產品。工業部分包括燃料、空氣、液體、氣體、電力、運動和燃燒的管理。該公司由 Amos W. Woodward 於 1870 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州柯林斯堡。

info.description: Adeia, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the invention, development, and licensing of innovations and technologies for entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Asia, Canada, Europe and Middle East, and Other. The company was founded on October 1, 2022 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

info.description_zh: Adeia, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於娛樂、媒體、消費性電子和半導體產業的創新和技術的發明、開發和授權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、亞洲、加拿大、歐洲和中東等。該公司成立於2022年10月1日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: biote Corp. is a woman-led company, which engages in providing bio identical hormone pellet therapy. It delivers a comprehensive, end-to-end platform that provides practitioners with medical education, training and certification, practice management software, and digital and point-of-care marketing support. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: Biote Corp. 是一家由女性領導的公司，致力於提供生物相同的荷爾蒙顆粒療法。它提供了一個全面的端到端平台，為從業人員提供醫學教育、培訓和認證、實踐管理軟體以及數位和護理點行銷支援。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Fortive Corp. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and marketing of professional and engineered products, software, and services for a variety of end markets. It operates through the following segments: Intelligent Operating Solutions, Precision Technologies, and Advanced Healthcare Solutions. The Intelligent Operating Solutions segment provides solutions to accelerate industrial and facility reliability and performance, as well as compliance and safety across a range of vertical end markets, including manufacturing, process industries, healthcare, utilities and power, communications, and electronics. The Precision Technologies segment supplies technologies such as electrical test and measurement instruments and services, energetic material devices, and a broad portfolio of sensor and control system solutions. The Advanced Healthcare Solutions segment serves healthcare customers with products and services for critical activities, including instrument and device reprocessing, instrument tracking, cell therapy equipment design and manufacturing, biomedical test tools, radiation safety monitoring, and asset management. The company was founded by James A. Lico and Stacey A. Walker on November 10, 2015 and is headquartered in Everett, WA.
info.description_zh: Fortive Corp. 致力於為各種終端市場設計、開發、製造和行銷專業工程產品、軟體和服務。它透過以下部門運作：智慧操作解決方案、精密技術和高級醫療解決方案。智慧操作解決方案部門提供解決方案，以提高工業和設施的可靠性和性能，以及一系列垂直終端市場的合規性和安全性，包括製造業、流程工業、醫療保健、公用事業和電力、通訊和電子產品。精密技術部門提供電氣測試和測量儀器及服務、含能材料設備以及廣泛的感測器和控制系統解決方案組合等技術。高級醫療保健解決方案部門為醫療保健客戶提供關鍵活動的產品和服務，包括儀器和設備再處理、儀器追蹤、細胞治療設備設計和製造、生物醫學測試工具、輻射安全監測和資產管理。該公司由 James A. Lico 和 Stacey A. Walker 於 2015 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州埃弗里特。

info.description: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which focuses on developing novel monoclonal antibody therapeutics for PsO and other I&I indications. Its pipeline includes ORKA-001 and ORKA-002. The company is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物技術公司，專注於開發針對 PsO 和其他 I&I 適應症的新型單株抗體療法。其管道包括ORKA-001和ORKA-002。該公司總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is a natural resource-based building materials company, which engages in the provision of aggregates including crushed stone, sand, and gravel through its network of quarries and distribution yards. It operates through the East Group and West Group segments. The East Group segment offers aggregates and asphalt products. The West Group segment focuses on aggregates, cement, downstream products, and paving services. The company was founded on November 12, 1993 and is headquartered in Raleigh, NC.
info.description_zh: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. 是一家以自然資源為基礎的建築材料公司，透過其採石場和配送場網路提供碎石、沙子和礫石等骨材。它透過東集團和西集團部門運作。 East Group 部門提供骨材和瀝青產品。西部集團部門專注於骨材、水泥、下游產品和鋪路服務。該公司成立於1993年11月12日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Ltd. engages in the management and development of casino gaming and entertainment resort facilities. It operates through the following segments: City of Dreams, Studio City, Altira Macau, Mocha and Other, City of Dreams Manila, City of Dreams Mediterranean & Other, Other Operations, and Corporate & Other. The company was founded by Yau Lung Ho in December 2004 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 新濠博亞娛樂有限公司從事賭場博彩及娛樂度假村設施的管理與開發。該公司透過以下部門運作：新濠天地、新濠影匯、澳門新濠鋒、摩卡及其他、馬尼拉新濠天地、地中海新濠天地及其他、其他業務部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由何遊龍於2004年12月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Myriad Genetics, Inc. engages in the discovery, development, and marketing of transformative molecular diagnostic tests. The company was founded by Walter A. Gilbert, Mark H. Skolnick, and Peter D. Meldrum in May 1991 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Myriad Genetics, Inc. 從事變革性分子診斷測試的發現、開發和行銷。該公司由 Walter A. Gilbert、Mark H. Skolnick 和 Peter D. Meldrum 於 1991 年 5 月創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves. It operates through the Upstream and Midstream Services segments. The Upstream segment focuses on the Permian Basin operations in West Texas. The Midstream Services segment is involved in the Midland and Delaware Basins. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Diamondback Energy, Inc.是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，從事非常規、陸上石油和天然氣儲量的收購、開發、勘探和開採。它透過上游和中游服務部門運作。上游部門專注於德克薩斯州西部的二疊紀盆地業務。中游服務部門涉及米德蘭和特拉華盆地。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, licensing, and globalizing biopharma innovations from around the world to deliver important medicines to patients. The company was founded Zheng Bin Yao and Stuart Lutzker on April 14, 2021 and is headquartered in Newtown Square, PA.
info.description_zh: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於識別、許可和全球化世界各地的生物製藥創新，為患者提供重要的藥物。該公司由鄭斌姚和斯圖爾特·盧茨克於 2021 年 4 月 14 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐敦廣場。

info.description: ProFrac Holding Corp. engages in the provision of hydraulic fracturing, proppant production, and other completion services. It operates through the following segments: Stimulation Services, Proppant Production, Manufacturing, and Other. The Stimulation Services segment owns a fleet of mobile hydraulic fracturing units and other auxiliary equipment that generates revenue by providing stimulation services to customers. The Proppant Production segment focuses on the provision of proppant to oilfield service providers and exploration and production companies. The Manufacturing segment is involved in the sale of products such as horsepower pumps, valves, piping, swivels, large-bore manifold systems, and fluid ends. The Other segment refers to Flotek Industries and Livewire Power, LLC. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Willow Park, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: ProFrac Holding Corp. 從事提供水力壓裂、支撐劑生產和其他完井服務。它透過以下部門運作：增產服務部門、支撐劑生產部門、製造部門和其他部門。增產服務部門擁有一批行動水力壓裂裝置和其他輔助設備，透過向客戶提供增產服務來創造收入。支撐劑生產部門專注於向油田服務提供者以及勘探和生產公司提供支撐劑。製造部門從事馬力幫浦、閥門、管路、旋轉接頭、大口徑歧管系統和流體端等產品的銷售。其他部門是指 Flotek Industries 和 Livewire Power, LLC。該公司成立於 2016 年，總部位於德克薩斯州威洛帕克。

info.description: TE Connectivity Plc is a company that engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. It operates under the following segments: Transportation Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Communications Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, relays, antennas, and application tooling. The Industrial Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, interventional medical components, relays, heat shrink tubing, and wire and cable. The Communications Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, antennas, and heat shrink tubing. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland.
info.description_zh: TE Con​​nectivity Plc 是一家致力於提供用於電力、訊號和資料分配的連接和感測器解決方案的公司。它的業務分為以下幾個部門：運輸解決方案、工業解決方案和通訊解決方案。運輸解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、感測器、繼電器、天線和應用工具。工業解決方案部門包括端子和連接器系統及組件、介入醫療組件、繼電器、熱縮管以及電線和電纜。通訊解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、天線和熱縮管。該公司成立於2007年，總部位於愛爾蘭戈爾韋。

info.description: Siebert Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of brokerage and financial advisory services. It conducts the following lines of business through wholly owned subsidiaries: Retail Brokerage Business, Investment Advisory Services, Insurance Services, Robo-Advisory Technology Development, and Prime Brokerage Services. The company was founded by Siebert Muriel F. on April 9, 1934 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Siebert Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供經紀和財務諮詢服務。它透過全資子公司開展以下業務：零售經紀業務、投資諮詢服務、保險服務、機器人諮詢技術開發和大宗經紀服務。該公司由 Siebert Muriel F. 於 1934 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: TJGC Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of marketing and advertising services. It offers one-stop advertising services to clients throughout the entire advertising process, which comprises the planning, creating, launching, managing, and performance monitoring of the advertisements. The company was founded by Kai Kwan Lam, Chi Fung Lau, and Chun Pong Siu on May 13, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: TJGC Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事提供行銷和廣告服務。為客戶提供廣告規劃、創作、投放、管理、成效監控等整個廣告流程的一站式廣告服務。該公司由林啟君、劉志峰和俊邦蕭於2022年5月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in research and development activities related to general business planning, including raising capital. It focuses on the discovery of therapies designed to treat immune-mediated diseases. The company was founded by Thomas A. Jordan and John E. Dowling on August 13, 2004 and is headquartered in Lexington, MA.
info.description_zh: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事與一般業務規劃相關的研發活動，包括募款。它專注於發現旨在治療免疫介導疾病的療法。該公司由 Thomas A. Jordan 和 John E. Dowling 於 2004 年 8 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州列剋星敦。

info.description: Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments engage in sales contracts for electrical components, industrial components, power distribution and assemblies, residential products, single and three phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution, power reliability equipment, and service. The Aerospace segment supplies aerospace fuel, hydraulics, and pneumatic systems for commercial and military use. The Vehicle segment deals with the design, manufacture, marketing, and supply of drivetrain and powertrain systems and critical components that reduce emissions and improve fuel economy, stability, performance and safety of cars, light trucks and commercial vehicles. The eMobility segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies electrical and electronic components and systems that improve the power management and performance of both on-road and off-road vehicles. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 伊頓公司是一家電力管理公司，為電力、液壓和機械動力提供節能解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global；航空航太、車輛和電動車。 Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global 部門從事電氣元件、工業元件、配電和組件、住宅產品、單相和三相電能品質、接線設備、電路保護、公用配電、電力可靠性設備和服務的銷售合約。航空航太部門提供商業和軍事用途的航空燃料、液壓和氣動系統。車輛部門從事傳動系統和動力系統以及關鍵部件的設計、製造、行銷和供應，以減少排放並提高轎車、輕型卡車和商用車的燃油經濟性、穩定性、性能和安全性。電動交通部門設計、製造、行銷和供應電氣和電子元件及系統，以改善公路和越野車輛的電源管理和性能。該公司成立於1911年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc. engages in the research and development of oncology-focused precision medicine. The firm focuses on the targeted therapeutics for patients selected using molecular diagnostics. Its product candidate, IDE196, is a protein kinase C inhibitor for genetically defined cancers having GNAQ and GNA11 gene mutations. The company was founded by Yujiro S. Hata and Jeffrey Hager in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc.從事以腫瘤學為重點的精準醫療的研發。該公司專注於為使用分子診斷選擇的患者提供標靶治療。其候選產品 IDE196 是一種蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑，用於治療具有 GNAQ 和 GNA11 基因突變的基因癌症。該公司由 Yujiro S. Hata 和 Jeffrey Hager 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: IPG Photonics Corp. engages in the provision of design, development, production and distribution of fiber lasers, laser systems, fiber amplifiers, and related optical components. Its products include lasers, beam delivery, medical, telecom equipment, product finder and components such as pump diodes, chillers, and mid-IR crystals. The company was founded by Valentin P. Gapontsev and Igor Samartsev in 1990 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: IPG Photonics Corp. 從事光纖雷射、雷射系統、光纖放大器和相關光學元件的設計、開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括雷射、光束傳輸、醫療、電信設備、產品查找器以及泵浦二極體、冷卻器和中紅外線晶體等組件。該公司由 Valentin P. Gapontsev 和 Igor Samartsev 於 1990 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Sterling Infrastructure, Inc. engages in the provision of construction solutions. It operates through the following segments: Transportation Solutions, E-Infrastructure Solutions, and Building Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment includes infrastructure and rehabilitation projects for highways, roads, bridges, airports, ports, light rail, water, wastewater, and storm drainage systems. The E-Infrastructure Solutions projects develop advanced, large-scale site development systems and services for data centers, e-commerce distribution centers, warehousing, transportation, energy, and more. The Building Solutions segment projects include residential and commercial concrete foundations for single-family and multi-family homes, parking structures, elevated slabs, and other concrete work. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Sterling Infrastructure, Inc. 從事提供建築解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：運輸解決方案、電子基礎設施解決方案和建築解決方案。交通解決方案部門包括高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場、港口、輕軌、水、廢水和暴雨排水系統的基礎設施和修復項目。電子基礎設施解決方案專案為資料中心、電子商務配送中心、倉儲、運輸、能源等開發先進的大型站點開發系統和服務。建築解決方案部門專案包括單戶和多戶住宅的住宅和商業混凝土基礎、停車場結構、高架板和其他混凝土工程。該公司成立於 1955 年，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Big Digital Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of digital asset infrastructure services. The company was founded on February 10, 2012 and is headquartered in Midland, PA.
info.description_zh: Big Digital Energy, Inc.從事提供數位資產基礎設施服務。該公司成立於2012年2月10日，總部位於賓州米德蘭市。

info.description: WeRide, Inc. operates as an investment holding company. It engages in the sale of autonomous driving vehicles, primarily including robobuses, robotaxis, robosweepers and related sensor suites. The company was founded by Tony Xu Han and Yan Li in February 2017 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 文遠知行文遠知行以投資控股公司經營。它從事自動駕駛車輛的銷售，主要包括機器人公車、機器人計程車、機器人掃地機和相關感測器套件。該公司由Tony Xu Han和Yan Li於2017年2月創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd. engages in developing and hosting hip-hop events. It provides brand promotion services, such as trademark and logo design, visual identity system design, brand positioning, brand personality design, and digital solution and other services as advertisement distribution to corporate clients. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
info.description_zh: 流行文化集團有限公司從事嘻哈活動的開發與主辦。提供企業客戶商標及標誌設計、視覺辨識系統設計、品牌定位、品牌個性設計、數位解決方案等品牌推廣服務及廣告投放等服務。公司成立於2007年，總部位於中國廈門。

info.description: Sadot Group, Inc. operates as a restaurant chain business. It operates through the following segments: Muscle Maker Grill Restaurant, Pokemoto Hawaiian Poke Restaurant, Non-Traditional (Hybrid), SuperFit Foods Meal Prep, and Sadot. The firm offers protein- based meals featuring chicken, seafood, pasta, hamburgers, wraps and flat breads. It also provides salads, protein shakes and fruit smoothies. The company was founded by Rodney C. Silva in 2022 and is headquartered in Burleson, TX.
info.description_zh: Sadot Group, Inc. 是一家連鎖餐廳企業。它透過以下部門運作：Muscle Maker Grill Restaurant、Pokemoto Hawaiian Poke Restaurant、非傳統（混合）、SuperFit Foods Meal Prep 和 Sadot。該公司提供蛋白質食品，包括雞肉、海鮮、義大利麵、漢堡、捲餅和扁麵包。它還提供沙拉、蛋白奶昔和水果冰沙。該公司由 Rodney C. Silva 於 2022 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伯利森。

info.description: Cartesian Growth Corp III is a blank-check company that is sponsored by Cartesian Capital Group LLC. The company aims to acquire or merge with an established, high-growth business seeking access to public markets and capital. The company provides financial and operational expertise post-combination.
info.description_zh: Cartesian Growth Corp III 是一家由 Cartesian Capital Group LLC 贊助的空白支票公司。該公司的目標是收購或合併一家成熟的、高成長的企業，尋求進入公開市場和資本的機會。該公司在合併後提供財務和營運專業知識。

info.description: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of lifecycle automotive services. It operates through the following segments: New Car Sales, Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales, and Automotive Insurance Related Services. The New Car Sales segment offers parallel import car and new energy vehicle (NEV). The Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales segment conducts business primarily to auto part dealers and gradually upgrade to directly connect to local multiple-brand-service (MBS) stores. The Automotive Insurance Related Services segment refers to the value-added maintenance, claim and repair, and insurance intermediation services. The company was founded by Hou Qi Zhang in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Autozi互聯網科技（全球）有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供汽車全生命週期服務。它透過以下部門運作：新車銷售部門、汽車零件及汽車配件銷售部門以及汽車保險相關服務部門。新車銷售部門提供平行進口汽車和新能源汽車（NEV）。汽車零配件銷售板塊主要針對汽車零配件經銷商開展業務，並逐步升級為直連當地多品牌服務（MBS）店。汽車保險相關服務部門是指加值保養、索賠和維修以及保險中介服務。該公司由張侯奇於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Solidion Technology, Inc. engages in researching, developing and manufacturing battery components and materials, batteries and related energy storage products for the automotive electric vehicle and other markets. The company was founded on June 30, 2023 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Solidion Technology, Inc.從事汽車電動車及其他市場的電池組件和材料、電池及相關儲能產品的研究、開發和製造。該公司成立於2023年6月30日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Digital Brands Group, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of apparel. Its portfolio brands include Bailey 44, DSTLD, Harper and Jones, Stateside, and Sundry. The company was founded by Corey Epstein, Mark T. Lynn, and Kevin Morris on September 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Digital Brands Group, Inc. 從事服裝的製造和銷售。其投資組合品牌包括 Bailey 44、DSTLD、Harper and Jones、Stateside 和 Sundry。該公司由 Corey Epstein、Mark T. Lynn 和 Kevin Morris 於 2012 年 9 月 17 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: HWH International, Inc. operates as a lifestyle business through a membership model. It enables home-based people in the new GIG economy to create lasting wealth. Its segments include HWH Marketplace, Hapi Cafe, Hapi Travel Destinations, and Hapi Wealth Builder. HWH Marketplace offers discounted sale of certain products, manufactured by affiliate company, Sharing Services Global Corp., to members. Hapi Cafe offers location-based social experiences where members can build a sense of community with like-minded customers with a potential interest in the same products. Hapi Travel Destinations aims to offer exclusive access to unpublished rates and discounts on air travel, cruises, car rentals, hotels, and resorts for members. Hapi Wealth Builder is exploring options of providing services to members through educational materials and seminars aimed at various types of investing opportunities. The company is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: HWH International, Inc. 透過會員模式經營生活風格企業。它使新零工經濟中的居家人們能夠創造持久的財富。其業務部門包括 HWH Marketplace、Hapi Cafe、Hapi Travel Destinations 和 Hapi Wealth Builder。 HWH Marketplace 向會員提供附屬公司Sharing Services Global Corp. 生產的某些產品的折扣銷售。 Hapi Cafe 提供基於位置的社交體驗，會員可以與對相同產品有潛在興趣的志同道合的客戶建立社區意識。 Hapi Travel Destinations 旨在為會員提供航空旅行、遊輪、汽車租賃、酒店和度假村未公佈的價格和折扣的獨家訪問權。 Hapi Wealth Builder 正在探索透過針對各種投資機會的教育材料和研討會向會員提供服務的選擇。該公司總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Smart Logistics Global Ltd. operates as a business-to-business contract logistics provider, specializing in industrial raw materials line-haul transportation. The company develops a smart logistics digital ecosystem for road transport by leveraging innovation, digital analytics, and infrastructure development. It enhances supply chain efficiency, shortens transit times, and improves client visibility using its integrated platform. Its services cater to a diverse range of industries including manufacturing, construction, and FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods), enabling seamless and cost-effective movement of goods across regional and national networks. The company was founded by Kwok Chiu Hue on October 8, 2020 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Smart Logistics Global Ltd. 是一家企業對企業合約物流供應商，專門從事工業原料的長程運輸。該公司利用創新、數位分析和基礎設施開發，開發道路運輸智慧物流數位生態系統。它利用其整合平台提高了供應鏈效率、縮短了運輸時間並提高了客戶可視性。其服務滿足製造業、建築業和快速消費品（FMCG）等多種行業的需求，實現跨區域和國家網絡的無縫且經濟高效的貨物運輸。該公司由Kwok Chiu Hue於2020年10月8日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. is multi-platform media company, which engages in the operation of radio stations in the United States. The firm offers marketing solutions across event platforms. It operates through the following business segments: Audio, Digital, and Other. The company was founded by George G. Beasley in 1961 and is headquartered in Naples, FL.
info.description_zh: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc.是一家多媒體平台公司，在美國從事廣播電台的營運。該公司提供跨活動平台的營銷解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：音訊、數位和其他。該公司由 George G. Beasley 於 1961 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州那不勒斯。

info.description: Senmiao Technology Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of automobile transaction and related services focusing on the ride-hailing industry. It also provides auto finance solutions through financing leases, car rental services to individual customers. It operates through the Automobile Transaction and Related Services, and the Online Ride-Hailing Platform Services segments. The company was founded in May 2014 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.description_zh: 森淼科技有限公司是一家控股公司，專注於叫車產業提供汽車交易及相關服務。它還透過融資租賃、汽車租賃服務為個人客戶提供汽車金融解決方案。它透過汽車交易及相關服務以及線上乘車平台服務部門運作。公司成立於2014年5月，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. is an energy transition company, which engages in providing turnkey clean energy production, storage, transportation, and fueling solutions. It also builds power and control systems for the energy industry in China. The company was founded by J. Casey Crenshaw on October 21, 1996 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. 是一家能源轉型公司，致力於提供統包清潔能源生產、儲存、運輸和燃料加註解決方案。它也為中國的能源產業建造電力和控制系統。該公司由 J. Casey Crenshaw 於 1996 年 10 月 21 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: ProShares UltraShort Top QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Mega Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the Daily Target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the largest companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index by targeting the performance of approximately the top 45% cumulative weight of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraShort Top QQQ 尋求扣除費用和支出之前的每日投資結果，該結果相當於 Nasdaq-100 Mega Index 每日表現的倒數 (-2x) 的兩倍。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在透過納斯達克 100 指數中約前 45% 累積權重的表現來衡量納斯達克 100 指數中最大的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ZK International Group Co., Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sales of stainless steel band, copper strip, welded stainless steel pipes and fittings, valve, light industry machinery equipment, and other stainless steel products. The company was founded by Jian Cong Huang and Guo Lin Wang on May 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 中康國際集團有限公司是一家控股公司，主要從事不銹鋼帶、銅帶、不銹鋼焊接管材及管件、閥門、輕工業機械設備等不銹鋼產品的製造和銷售。該公司由黃健聰和王果林於2015年5月13日創立，總部位於中國溫州。

info.description: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that involves clinical development and commercialization of high-value medicines. Its platforms, Captisol and NITRICI, offer technology with broad applicability in drug development to a large network of biopharmaceutical partners, including the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in the world. The company was founded by Ronald M. Evans in 1987 and is headquartered in Jupiter, FL.
info.description_zh: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，涉及高價值藥物的臨床開發和商業化。其 Captisol 和 NITRICI 平台為包括世界上最大的製藥製造商在內的大型生物製藥合作夥伴網路提供在藥物開發方面具有廣泛適用性的技術。該公司由 Ronald M. Evans 於 1987 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朱庇特。

info.description: GBank Financial Holdings, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: GBank Financial Holdings, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services, demand, savings and time deposits, consumer, mortgage and commercial loans. It offers telephone banking, internet banking, and mobile banking to its customers. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Berryville, VA.
info.description_zh: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，從事提供零售和商業銀行服務、活期存款、儲蓄和定期存款、消費者貸款、抵押貸款和商業貸款。它為客戶提供電話銀行、網路銀行和手機銀行。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州貝裡維爾。

info.description: Infobird Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of standard and customized customer relationship management cloud-based services. It offers software-as-a-service (SaaS) and business process outsourcing (BPO) services to clients. The company was founded on October 26, 2001 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Infobird Co. Ltd.是一家控股公司，致力於提供標準和客製化的客戶關係管理雲端服務。它為客戶提供軟體即服務（SaaS）和業務流程外包（BPO）服務。公司成立於2001年10月26日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Preferred Bank engages in offering financial services. Its services include demand, time, and savings deposits, and real estate, business, and consumer lending. The company was founded by Li Yu on September 9, 1991 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: 優先銀行從事提供金融服務。其服務包括活期存款、定期存款和儲蓄存款，以及房地產、商業和消費貸款。該公司由李宇於1991年9月9日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: First Business Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It offers treasury and investment management, commercial lending, equipment finance, retirement plans, trust and estate administration, private banking and asset-based lending. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.description_zh: First Business Financial Services, Inc. 作為銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。它提供財務和投資管理、商業貸款、設備融資、退休計劃、信託和遺產管理、私人銀行和資產貸款。該公司成立於 1986 年，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of small, mid and large capitalization companies that comprise the community banking industry.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤社區銀行業中小型、中型和大型資本公司的表現。

info.description: Sentage Holdings, Inc. engages in the financial services, which offers a comprehensive range of financial services across consumer loan repayment and collection management, loan recommendation, and prepaid payment network services in China. The company was founded on September 16, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Sentage Holdings, Inc.從事金融服務業務，在中國提供涵蓋消費貸款還款和催收管理、貸款推薦以及預付支付網路服務等全方位的金融服務。公司成立於2019年9月16日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of waste management solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Concrete Pumping, U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services, and the U.K. Operations. The U.S. Concrete Pumping segment includes services under the Brundage-Bone and Capital Pumping trade names. The U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services segment is involved in the pans and containers rented to customers and the disposal services under the Eco-Pan trade name. The U.K. Operations segment relates to the concrete pumping services and leasing of concrete pumping equipment to customers under the Camfaud Concrete Pumps and Premier Concrete Pumping trade names. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. 從事提供廢棄物管理解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國混凝土泵送部門、美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門和英國營運部門。美國混凝土泵送部門包括以 Brundage-Bone 和 Capital Pumping 商標名稱提供的服務。美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門提供向客戶出租的盤子和容器以及以 Eco-Pan 商標名稱提供的處置服務。英國營運部門涉及混凝土泵送服務以及以 Camfaud Concrete Pumps 和 Premier Concrete Pumping 商標名向客戶租賃混凝土泵送設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the business of owning the Bank, Peoples Bank and PEBK Capital Trust II. It operates through the following segments: Banking Operations, Community Bank Real Estate Solutions, LLC (CBRES), and Other. The Banking Operations segment focuses on the consolidated bank. The CBRES segment provides appraisal management services to community banks. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Newton, NC.
info.description_zh: Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事控股銀行、Peoples Bank 和 PEBK Capital Trust II 業務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行業務部門、社區銀行房地產解決方案有限責任公司（CBRES）和其他部門。銀行業務部門專注於合併銀行。 CBRES 部門為社區銀行提供評估管理服務。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州牛頓。

info.description: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services, including business banking, personal banking and wealth management, and trust services. It operates through the Commercial Banking and Wealth Management Services segment. The Commercial Banking segment includes commercial, residential and consumer lending activities, mortgage banking activities, deposit generation, cash management activities and direct banking activities, which include the operation of ATMs, telephone and internet banking services and customer support and sales. The Wealth Management Services segment consists of investment management, financial planning, personal trust and estate services, including services as trustee, personal representative, custodian and guardian and institutional trust services are also provided, including fiduciary services. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Westerly, RI.
info.description_zh: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務，包括商業銀行、個人銀行和財富管理以及信託服務。它透過商業銀行和財富管理服務部門運作。商業銀行部門包括商業、住宅和消費貸款活動、抵押銀行活動、存款產生、現金管理活動和直接銀行活動，其中包括自動櫃員機的營運、電話和網路銀行服務以及客戶支援和銷售。財富管理服務部門包括投資管理、財務規劃、個人信託和遺產服務，包括受託人、個人代表、保管人和監護人服務，也提供機構信託服務，包括信託服務。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於羅德島州韋斯特利。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLP ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLP Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the consumer staples sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLP ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLP 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場消費必需品產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Old Second Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company. It engages in the provision of traditional retail and commercial banking services through its wholly owned subsidiaries. Its services includes personal banking, loans, business banking, and wealth management. The firm operates through the community banking segment. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Aurora, IL.
info.description_zh: Old Second Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司。它透過其全資子公司提供傳統零售和商業銀行服務。其服務包括個人銀行業務、貸款、商業銀行業務和財富管理。該公司透過社區銀行業務部門運作。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於伊利諾州奧羅拉。

info.description: Meridian Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking services. It operates through the following segments: Banking, Meridian Wealth, and Mortgage Banking. The Banking segment consists of commercial and retail banking. The Meridian Wealth segment offers wealth management services and products. The Mortgage Banking segment consists of the central loan production facility and retail and profit sharing loan production offices. The company was founded by Christopher J. Annas on June 8, 2009 and is headquartered in Malvern, PA.
info.description_zh: Meridian Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供商業和消費者銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、Meridian Wealth 部門和抵押銀行部門。銀行業務部門包括商業銀行業務和零售銀行業務。 Meridian Wealth 部門提供財富管理服務和產品。抵押銀行業務部門由中央貸款生產設施以及零售和利潤分享貸款生產辦公室組成。該公司由 Christopher J. Annas 於 2009 年 6 月 8 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州馬爾文。

info.description: Fifth Third Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of diversified financial services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Consumer and Small Business Banking, and Wealth and Asset Management. The Commercial Banking segment offers credit intermediation, cash management, and financial services to large and middle-market businesses and government and professional customers. The Consumer and Small Business Banking segment provides a full range of deposit and loan products to individuals and small businesses through a network of full-service banking centers and relationships with indirect and correspondent loan originators in addition to providing products designed to meet the specific needs of small businesses, including cash management services. The Wealth and Asset Management segment provides wealth management solutions for individuals, companies, and not-for-profit organizations including wealth planning, investment management, banking, insurance, trust, and estate services. The company was founded on October 7, 1974 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Fifth Third Bancorp是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供多元化金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、消費者和小型企業銀行部門以及財富和資產管理部門。商業銀行部門為大中型市場企業以及政府和專業客戶提供信貸中介、現金管理和金融服務。消費者和小型企業銀行部門透過全方位服務銀行中心網路以及與間接和代理貸款發起人的關係，向個人和小型企業提供全方位的存款和貸款產品，此外還提供旨在滿足小型企業特定需求的產品，包括現金管理服務。財富與資產管理部門為個人、公司和非營利組織提供財富管理解決方案，包括財富規劃、投資管理、銀行、保險、信託和房地產服務。該公司成立於 1974 年 10 月 7 日，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: BayCom Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services to businesses and business owners, as well as individuals. It focuses on passive investment activities and oversight of its investment to its bank subsidiary. The company was founded by George J. Guarini, Lloyd W. Kendall, Jr., James S. Camp, and Robert G. Laverne in July 2004 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.
info.description_zh: BayCom Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於為企業和企業主以及個人提供金融服務。它專注於被動投資活動以及對其銀行子公司的投資進行監督。該公司由 George J. Guarini、Lloyd W. Kendall, Jr.、James S. Camp 和 Robert G. Laverne 於 2004 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州核桃溪。

info.description: Medpace Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of outsourced clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. The firm's services include medical department, clinical trial management, data-driven feasibility, study-start-up, clinical monitoring, regulatory affairs, patient recruitment and retention, medical writing, biometrics and data sciences, pharmacovigilance, core laboratory, laboratories, clinics, and quality assurance. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, Belgium, Asia-Pacific, and Other. The company was founded by August James Troendle in 1992 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Medpace Holdings, Inc. 致力於為生物技術、製藥和醫療器材產業提供外包臨床開發服務。該公司的服務包括醫療部門、臨床試驗管理、數據驅動的可行性、研究啟動、臨床監測、監管事務、患者招募和保留、醫學寫作、生物識別和數據科學、藥物警戒、核心實驗室、實驗室、診所和品質保證。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、比利時、亞太地區和其他地區。該公司由 August James Troendle 於 1992 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Zions Bancorporation NA is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of full banking and related services. It operates through the following segments: Zions Bank, Amegy Bank, California Bank & Trust, National Bank of Arizona, Nevada State Bank, Vectra Bank Colorado, and The Commerce Bank of Washington. The company was founded on February 17, 1961, and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Zions Bancorporation NA 是一家銀行控股公司，提供全面的銀行及相關服務。它透過以下部門運作：Zions Bank、Amegy Bank、California Bank & Trust、National Bank of Arizona、Nevada State Bank、Vectra Bank Colorado 和 The Commerce Bank of Washington。該公司成立於 1961 年 2 月 17 日，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of customized transportation and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: Contract Logistics, Intermodal, and Trucking. The Contract Logistics segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Intermodal segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Trucking segment includes dry van, flatbed, heavy-haul, and refrigerated operations, transporting a broad range of commodities including automotive parts, machinery, building materials, food products, steel, and other industrial and consumer goods. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Warren, MI.
info.description_zh: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供客製化運輸和物流解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：合約物流、多式聯運和卡車運輸。合約物流部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。多式聯運部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。卡車運輸部門包括乾貨車、平板車、重載和冷藏業務，運輸各種商品，包括汽車零件、機械、建築材料、食品、鋼鐵以及其他工業和消費品。該公司成立於 1932 年，總部位於密西根州沃倫。

info.description: Merchants Bancorp is a bank holding company, which specializes in multiple lines of business in banking and finance. It operates through the following segments: Multi-Family Mortgage Banking, Mortgage Warehousing, Banking, and Other. The Multi-Family Mortgage Banking segment deals with mortgage banking, specializing in originating and servicing loans for multi-family rental housing and healthcare facility financing, particularly for senior living properties. The Mortgage Warehousing segment funds agency eligible loans for non-depository financial institutions from the date of origination or purchase until the date of sale to an investor. The Banking segment refers to financial products and services to consumers and businesses, including commercial, commercial real estate, mortgage, and other consumer loan products, and letters of credit and various types of deposit products, including checking, savings and time deposit accounts. The company was founded by Michael Petrie and Randall D. Rogers in 1990 and is headquartered in Carmel, IN.
info.description_zh: Merchants Bancorp 是一家銀行控股公司，專注於銀行和金融領域的多個業務領域。它透過以下部門運作：多戶抵押銀行業務、抵押倉儲業務、銀行業務和其他業務。多戶型抵押貸款銀行業務部門從事抵押貸款銀行業務，專門為多戶型租賃住房和醫療保健設施融資（特別是老年住宅物業）提供貸款並提供服務。抵押倉儲部門為非存款金融機構提供代理合格貸款的資金，從發放或購買之日起直至出售給投資者之日。銀行業務部門是指為消費者和企業提供金融產品和服務，包括商業、商業房地產、抵押貸款和其他消費貸款產品、信用證和各種類型的存款產品，包括支票、儲蓄和定期存款帳戶。該公司由 Michael Petrie 和 Randall D. Rogers 於 1990 年創立，總部位於印第安納州卡梅爾。

info.description: First National Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of consumer and business banking services through its subsidiary. It offers savings, checking, mortgage lending, home equity, treasury management, construction loan, commercial mortgage, and rental properties. The company was founded on September 7, 1983 and is headquartered in Strasburg, VA.
info.description_zh: First National Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，透過其子公司提供消費者和商業銀行服務。它提供儲蓄、支票、抵押貸款、房屋淨值、財務管理、建築貸款、商業抵押貸款和租賃房產。該公司成立於 1983 年 9 月 7 日，總部位於維吉尼亞州斯特拉斯堡。

info.description: Ames National Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services through its subsidiaries. Its activities include personal, business, agricultural and commercial lending, management of the investment securities portfolio, deposit account services, and wealth management services. The company was founded on January 21, 1975 and is headquartered in Ames, IA.
info.description_zh: Ames National Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行服務。其業務包括個人、企業、農業和商業貸款、投資證券組合管理、存款帳戶服務和財富管理服務。該公司成立於 1975 年 1 月 21 日，總部位於愛荷華州艾姆斯。

info.description: WesBanco, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the Community Banking and Trust and Investment Services segments. The Community Banking segment delivers services traditionally offered by service commercial banks, including commercial demand, individual demand, and time deposit accounts, as well as commercial, mortgage, and individual installment loans, and certain non-traditional offerings, such as insurance and securities brokerage services. The Trust and Investment Services segment includes trust services as well as alternative investment products including mutual funds. The company was founded on January 20, 1870 and is headquartered in Wheeling, WV.
info.description_zh: WesBanco, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務。它透過社區銀行以及信託和投資服務部門運作。社區銀行業務部門提供傳統上由服務性商業銀行提供的服務，包括商業活期存款、個人活期存款和定期存款帳戶，以及商業、抵押貸款和個人分期貸款，以及某些非傳統產品，例如保險和證券經紀服務。信託和投資服務部門包括信託服務以及共同基金等另類投資產品。該公司成立於 1870 年 1 月 20 日，總部位於西維吉尼亞州惠靈。

info.description: CF Bankshares, Inc. operates as a financial holding company which is engaged in the provision of business banking products and services. Its products and services include commercial loans and leases, commercial and residential real estate loans and treasury management depository services. It operates through the Real Estate and Consumer segments. The company was founded in September 1998 and is headquartered in Columbus, OH.
info.description_zh: CF Bankshares, Inc. 作為金融控股公司運營，提供商業銀行產品和服務。其產品和服務包括商業貸款和租賃、商業和住宅房地產貸款以及資金管理託管服務。它透過房地產和消費者部門運作。該公司成立於 1998 年 9 月，總部位於俄亥俄州哥倫布。

info.description: Business First Bancshares, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of banking products and services through its subsidiary. It also offers commercial and personal banking, treasury management, and wealth solutions services. The company was founded on July 20, 2006 and is headquartered in Baton Rouge, LA.
info.description_zh: Business First Bancshares, Inc.是一家金融控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行產品和服務。它還提供商業和個人銀行業務、資金管理和財富解決方案服務。該公司成立於2006年7月20日，總部位於路易斯安那州巴吞魯日。

info.description: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc engages in the distribution and sale of non-alcoholic ready-to-drink beverages. It operates through the following geographical segments: Iberia, Germany, Great Britain, France, Belgium and Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden, and Iceland. The Iberia segment refers to Spain, Portugal, and Andorra. The France segment includes continental France and Monaco. The company was founded on August 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Uxbridge, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: 可口可樂歐洲太平洋合作夥伴有限公司從事非酒精即飲飲料的經銷和銷售。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：伊比利亞半島、德國、英國、法國、比利時和盧森堡、荷蘭、挪威、瑞典和冰島。伊比利亞航段指西班牙、葡萄牙和安道爾。法國部分包括法國本土和摩納哥。該公司成立於2015年8月4日，總部位於英國烏克斯布里奇。

info.description: The Cooper Cos, Inc. operates as a medical device company. It operates through the Cooper Vision and Cooper Surgical segments. The Cooper Vision segment develops, manufactures, and markets products for contact lens wearers, which solves vision challenges such as astigmatism, presbyopia, myopia, ocular dryness, and eye fatigues. The Cooper Surgical segment focuses on the provision of advancement for the health of women, babies, and families through women's health and fertility products and services. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Ramon, CA.
info.description_zh: Cooper Cos, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司。它透過 Cooper Vision 和 Cooper Surgical 部門運作。 Cooper Vision 部門為隱形眼鏡配戴者開發、製造和銷售產品，解決散光、老花眼、近視、眼乾澀和眼睛疲勞等視力挑戰。 Cooper Surgical 部門專注於透過婦女健康和生育產品和服務促進婦女、嬰兒和家庭的健康。該公司成立於 1958 年，總部位於加州聖拉蒙。

info.description: Independent Bank Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It offers commercial banking, mortgage lending, investments, and title services. The company was founded in 1864 and is headquartered in Grand Rapids, MI.
info.description_zh: Independent Bank Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，提供金融服務。它提供商業銀行、抵押貸款、投資和產權服務。該公司成立於 1864 年，總部位於密西根州大急流城。

info.description: ICF International, Inc. engages in the provision of professional services and technology-based solutions to government and commercial clients, including management, marketing, technology, and policy consulting and implementation services. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: ICF International, Inc.致力於為政府和商業客戶提供專業服務和基於技術的解決方案，包括管理、行銷、技術以及政策諮詢和實施服務。該公司成立於 1969 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: Huntington Bancshares, Inc. engages in the provision of full-service commercial and consumer deposit, lending, and other banking services. It operates through Consumer and Regional Banking, Commercial Banking, and Treasury and Other. The Consumer and Regional Banking segment provides a wide array of financial products and services to consumer and business customers including deposits, lending, payments, mortgage banking, dealer financing, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance, and other financial products and services. The Commercial Banking segment is involved in expertise through bankers, capabilities, and digital channels, and includes a comprehensive set of product offerings. The Treasury and Other segment relates to technology and operations, as well as other unallocated assets, liabilities, revenues, and expenses. The company was founded in 1866 and is headquartered in Columbus, OH.
info.description_zh: Huntington Bancshares, Inc. 從事提供全方位商業和消費者存款、貸款和其他銀行服務。它透過消費者和區域銀行業務、商業銀行業務以及財政及其他業務開展業務。消費者和區域銀行業務部門為消費者和企業客戶提供廣泛的金融產品和服務，包括存款、貸款、支付、抵押銀行、經銷商融資、投資管理、信託、經紀、保險和其他金融產品和服務。商業銀行部門透過銀行家、能力和數位管道提供專業知識，並提供一整套全面的產品。財務和其他部門涉及技術和運營，以及其他未分配的資產、負債、收入和支出。該公司成立於 1866 年，總部位於俄亥俄州哥倫布。

info.description: Proem Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Proem Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月22日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Nuvalent, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on creating precisely targeted therapies for patients with cancer. Its pipeline includes ROS1 NSCLC, ALK NSCLC and HER2 NSCLC. The company was founded by Matthew D. Shair in January 2017 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Nuvalent, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於為癌症患者創造精確的標靶療法。其管道包括ROS1 NSCLC、ALK NSCLC和HER2 NSCLC。該公司由 Matthew D. Shair 於 2017 年 1 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: BGM Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the technology fields of AI application, intelligent robots, algorithmic computing power, cloud computing, and biopharmaceuticals. It operates through the following segments: Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and Traditional Chinese Medicine Derivatives (TCMD); Heparin Products and Sausage Casing; and Fertilizer. info.description_zh: BGM Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，涉足人工智慧應用、智慧機器人、演算法算力、雲端運算、生物製藥等技術領域。它透過以下部門運作：土黴素和甘草產品部門，以及中藥衍生品部門（TCMD）；肝素產品和腸衣；和肥料。土黴素和甘草產品以及TCMD部門專注於土黴素產品、甘草產品和TCMD的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。肝素產品和腸衣部門治療心血管疾病、腦血管疾病和血液透析。肥料業務包括雄冠、有機肥料和雄冠、有機無機復混肥。公司成立於2019年2月7日，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Burke Herbert Financial Services Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking products and financial services to small to medium-sized businesses, their owners and employees, professional corporations, non-profits, and individuals. It operates through the following loan portfolio segments: Commercial Real Estate, Owner-Occupied Commercial Real Estate, Acquisition, Construction, and Development, Commercial and Industrial, Single Family Residential (1-4 Units), and Consumer Non-Real Estate and Other. The Commercial Real Estate segment includes leasing of the real estate collateral or income generated from the sale of the collateral. The Owner-Occupied Commercial Real Estate segment focuses on the operations of the business that occupies the property and the value of the collateral. The Acquisition, Construction, and Development segment offers creditworthiness of the borrower, project completion within budget, sale after completion, and the value of the collateral. The Commercial and Industrial segment is involved in the operations of the business and the value of the collateral. The Single Family Residential (1-4 Units) segment provides loans for investment purpose carry risk associated with the continued creditworthiness of the borrower, the value of the collateral, and either the net operating income generated from the lease of the real estate collateral or income generated from the sale of the collateral. The Consumer Non-Real Estate and Other segment covers loans carry risk associated with the creditworthiness of the borrower and the value of the collateral. The company was founded on September 14, 2022 and is headquartered in Alexandria, VA.
info.description_zh: Burke Herbert Financial Services Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於向中小型企業及其所有者和員工、專業公司、非營利組織和個人提供銀行產品和金融服務。它透過以下貸款組合部門運作：商業房地產、業主自用商業房地產、收購、建造和開發、商業和工業、單戶住宅（1-4 套）以及消費非房地產和其他。商業房地產部門包括房地產抵押品的租賃或出售抵押品產生的收入。業主自用商業房地產部門專注於佔用該房產的企業的運作以及抵押品的價值。收購、建造和開發部門提供借款人的信譽、預算內的專案完成、完成後的銷售以及抵押品的價值。商業和工業部門涉及業務運營和抵押品價值。單戶住宅（1-4 套）部門提供用於投資目的的貸款，其風險與借款人的持續信譽、抵押品的價值以及租賃房地產抵押品產生的淨營業收入或出售抵押品產生的收入有關。消費者非房地產及其他部門涵蓋具有與借款人信用度和抵押品價值相關的風險的貸款。該公司成立於 2022 年 9 月 14 日，總部位於維吉尼亞州亞歷山大。

info.description: Bon Natural Life Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of functional active ingredients extracted from natural herb plants which are widely used by manufacturer customers in the functional food, personal care, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical industries. It offers fragrance compounds, health supplemental powder drinks, and bioactive food ingredients. The company was founded by Yong Wei Hu in 2006 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.
info.description_zh: Bon Natural Life Ltd.從事從天然草本植物中提取的功能性活性成分的研發、製造和銷售，這些成分被功能性食品、個人護理、化妝品和製藥行業的製造商客戶廣泛使用。它提供香料化合物、保健補充粉末飲料和生物活性食品成分。該公司由胡勇偉於2006年創立，總部位於中國西安。

info.description: Tianci International, Inc. engages in the provision of global logistics services, specializing in ocean freight forwarding, including container and bulk goods shipping. It offers its services across the Asia-Pacific region, including Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Vietnam. The company was founded on June 13, 2012 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

info.description: ZW Data Action Technologies, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a one-stop services on omni-channel advertising, precision marketing, and data analysis management system. It operates through the following segments: Internet Advertising and Data Services, Ecommerce O2O Advertising and Marketing Services, Blockchain Technology, and Corporate. The company was founded by Han Dong Cheng and Zhi Ge Zhang in 2003 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: ZW Data Action Technologies, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事全通路廣告、精準行銷、資料分析管理系統一站式服務營運。它還從事區塊鏈支援的網路/行動應用程式的開發和軟體解決方案的提供。它透過以下部門運作：網路廣告和數據服務部門、電子商務O2O廣告和行銷服務部門、區塊鏈技術部門和企業部門。該公司由成漢東和張志革於2003年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. produces and distributes doughnuts. It offers yeast-raised doughnuts, pies, coffees and espresso drinks, chillers and iced beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. and Canada, International, and Market Development. The U.S. and Canada segment includes all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the U.S. and Canada, Insomnia-branded retail shops and consumer packaged goods operations. The International segment consists of all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Mexico. The Market Development segment handles the franchise operations across the globe, as well as Krispy Kreme company-owned shops in Japan. The firm sells its products through mass merchant, grocery and convenience stores. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Krispy Kreme, Inc. 生產和分銷甜甜圈。它提供酵母甜甜圈、餡餅、咖啡和濃縮咖啡、冰鎮飲料和冰鎮飲料。它透過以下部門運作：美國和加拿大部門、國際部門和市場開發部門。美國和加拿大部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在美國和加拿大的所有業務、Insomnia 品牌零售店和消費品業務。國際部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在英國、愛爾蘭、澳洲、紐西蘭和墨西哥的所有業務。市場開發部門負責全球範圍內的特許經營業務以及 Krispy Kreme 公司在日本的自營商店。該公司透過大型商家、雜貨店和便利商店銷售其產品。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Big Tree Cloud Holdings Ltd. engages in providing personal care products through its subsidiaries. Its products include sanitary napkins, sanitary pants, and panty liners. The company was founded by Wen Quan Zhu in 2020 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 大樹雲控股有限公司透過其子公司提供個人護理產品。其產品包括衛生棉、衛生褲和護墊。該公司由朱文泉於2020年創立，總部位於中國深圳。
